# Executive Summary

This report summarizes exploratory analysis of the SwiftKey text data.

# Data Loading

The English datasets from blogs, news and Twitter were loaded.

## Dataset Comparison

```{r}
summaryTable <- data.frame(
  File = c("Blogs","News","Twitter"),
  Lines = c(899288,1010242,2360148),
  Words = c(37546250,34762395,30093413)
)

barplot(
  summaryTable$Words,
  names.arg = summaryTable$File,
  col = c("blue","green","red"),
  main = "Word Counts by Dataset"
)
```

## Basic Statistics

```{r}
summaryTable
```

## Findings

The Blogs dataset contains the highest number of words.

The Twitter dataset contains the highest number of lines.

A sample of the data was selected for exploratory analysis and future predictive modeling.
